# Birds of the Air (Matthew 6:26)

## Emotional Focus
Thankfulness that our Heavenly Father feeds even the tiny birds.

## Key KJV
“Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?” (Matthew 6:26)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus pointed to the birds flying overhead. They don’t plant gardens or store food, but God feeds every single one. We are even more precious to Him.

## Coloring Prompt
Cheerful birds flying and eating seeds on the ground under a bright blue sky.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Your Father in heaven knows what you need. Thank Him for taking care of you.”
